# CDenn - Full-Stack Software Developer

> CDenn is the professional brand of Dennis Ndung'u, a Nairobi-based full-stack developer building reliable Next.js products, multi-tenant platforms, AI-assisted tools, offline-first applications, and payments API integrations for global teams.

## About

Dennis Ndung'u (CDenn) specialises in Next.js and React applications, TypeScript,
Node.js, Python/FastAPI, Flutter, Rust, PostgreSQL, multi-tenant SaaS architecture,
payments API integrations, AI-assisted product features, and offline-first software.

CDenn is a software development brand, not the unrelated cDENN protein-domain term
from molecular biology.

### Featured projects

- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/bancassurance-platform - NDA-protected multi-tenant bancassurance SaaS with tenant isolation, RBAC, audit logging, and maker-checker workflows.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/warehouselens - AI-assisted, multi-tenant warehouse operations platform with warehouse-scoped RBAC, tool-routed copilot answers, and demand forecasting.
- https://warehouselens.cdenn.dev - Live WarehouseLens deployment.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/opsis - Self-hosted production-control platform for church media teams, using a Next.js BFF, Rust control core, and live OBS WebSocket integration.
- https://opsis.cdenn.dev - Live Opsis deployment.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/steward - Financial governance platform for faith-based organisations, with staged approvals, role-based permissions, and receipt tracking.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/email-refiner - AI-powered Chrome extension that refines email tone directly inside Gmail and Zimbra.
- https://refine-mail-web.vercel.app/ - Email Refiner product site.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/ndoa-plan - Offline-first wedding coordination platform with payment reconciliation, local-first sync, and event operations tooling.
- https://ndoa-plan.vercel.app - Ndoa Plan product site.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/sefer - Offline Android PDF reader with library management and persistent annotations.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/mathesis - Search-first, multi-discipline learning platform with reference and interactive learning modes.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/near-field - Flutter and Kotlin NFC alarm clock built for reliable scheduling across deep sleep and device restarts.
- https://www.cdenn.dev/solutions/gik-souls-app - Offline-first Flutter mission follow-up app using clean architecture, Drift storage, and background sync.

## Technical strengths

- Multi-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, RBAC, JWT-based authentication, audit trails, and approval workflows.
- AI-assisted systems: tool-routed copilots, structured agent workflows, evaluation harnesses, and permission-aware answers.
- Full-stack engineering: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Rust, PostgreSQL, Docker, WebSockets, and API design.
- Offline-first mobile and web: Flutter, Drift, Dexie, SQLite, durable sync queues, and conflict resolution.
- Payments systems: payments API integrations, webhooks, idempotent callback handling, reconciliation, and multi-tenant ledger architecture.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Who is CDenn?
A: CDenn is the professional software-development brand of Dennis Ndung'u, a full-stack developer based in Nairobi, Kenya.

Q: What does CDenn build?
A: CDenn builds web applications, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, AI-assisted tools, offline-first mobile products, payments systems, Chrome extensions, and self-hosted software.

Q: Is CDenn related to the cDENN protein term?
A: No. CDenn (cdenn.dev) is a software-development brand and has no connection to the cDENN protein-domain term in molecular biology.

Q: Where is CDenn based?
A: CDenn is based in Nairobi, Kenya and works with global teams through remote collaboration.

Q: How can I work with CDenn?
A: Use the contact form at https://www.cdenn.dev/#contact for full-time, contract, consulting, or custom-software enquiries.
